name: capocantiere
description: Claude acts as manager and delegates implementation and analysis tasks to configurable workers: external coding-agent CLIs such as GitHub Copilot CLI, Mistral Vibe and OpenAI Codex CLI. Isolated git worktrees, parallel jobs, per-worker budgets with automatic fallback, controlled review and apply.

copilot_token.title: GitHub token for the copilot worker (optional)
copilot_token.description: A fine-grained personal access token with only the "Copilot Requests" permission. Given only to the Copilot CLI, as COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN. Leave empty to use the CLI's own login (copilot login).

vibe_token.title: Mistral API key for the vibe worker (optional)
vibe_token.description: Given only to Mistral Vibe, as MISTRAL_API_KEY. Leave empty to use the CLI's own sign-in.

codex_token.title: OpenAI API key for the codex worker (optional)
codex_token.description: Given only to the Codex CLI, as CODEX_API_KEY. Leave empty to use the CLI's own login (codex login).

agy_token.title: Gemini API key for the agy worker (optional)
agy_token.description: A Gemini API key from Google AI Studio, given only to the Antigravity CLI, as GEMINI_API_KEY. The agy worker stays disabled until you enable it in workers.json.
